name: Auto Nightmare
description: One-click full-level decoration with a Slaughterhouse-inspired dark red and black preset.

show-editor-button.name: Show Editor Button
show-editor-button.description: Show a floating Deco button in the level editor. You can always open Auto Nightmare from the editor pause menu too.

button-position.name: Button Position
button-position.description: Where the floating button sits. If it overlaps another editor button, pick another spot or use the offsets below.

open-popup-keybind.name: Open Auto Nightmare
open-popup-keybind.description: Opens the Auto Nightmare window while you are in the level editor.

max-objects.name: Max Objects Per Run
max-objects.description: Safety cap on how many decoration objects one run may add. Lower this if the editor lags.

base-channel.name: First Color Channel
base-channel.description: Auto Nightmare uses 6 color channels starting here (default 981-986). Change it if your level already uses those channels.

recolor-layout.name: Recolor Layout Blocks
recolor-layout.description: With Theme Colors on, also sets the built-in Obj channel (1004) so default blocks match the preset.

deco-editor-layer.name: Deco Editor Layer
deco-editor-layer.description: Put all generated decoration on this editor layer so you can hide or lock it easily. 0 = don't change the layer.
